01 · The first 50

The first fifty,
as the widget deals them

TOPIK II awards levels 3 to 6 by score, and the National Institute of Korean Language publishes its intermediate vocabulary as one band for levels 3 and 4 rather than a list per level. This page holds that band: 2,154 words, which Lock&Learn Korean splits by frequency into the Intermediate 1 and Intermediate 2 packs. Every entry shows the hangul, its Revised Romanization and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Korean this list is the Intermediate 1 and Intermediate 2 packs: a word waits in hangul with its romanization; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. Intermediate 1 and Intermediate 2 open with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hangul, romanization or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the TOPIK II Intermediate vocabulary list?

2,154. The National Institute of Korean Language grades its learner vocabulary as beginner, intermediate and advanced rather than by TOPIK level. The beginner band, which is the TOPIK I vocabulary, holds about 1,800 words; the intermediate and advanced bands about 2,150 and 2,550.

Why does this page show 50 of the 2,154 words?

The complete TOPIK II Intermediate list is the Intermediate 1 and Intermediate 2 packs in Lock&Learn Korean. This page shows the first 50 words the widget deals, enough to judge the level and to try the flashcards. In the app the packs open with a free preview, another word unlocks daily, and Lock&Learn+ opens all 2,154 at once.

Is this the official TOPIK Levels 3 and 4 word list?

TOPIK itself publishes no vocabulary list. This page follows the National Institute of Korean Language (NIKL) learner vocabulary, the list TOPIK preparation is built on, in the TOPIK II Intermediate band. The English meanings are Lock&Learn glosses, not an official translation.

How do I study the TOPIK II Intermediate list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Korean, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Korean. The Intermediate 1 and Intermediate 2 packs put these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. Intermediate 1 and Intermediate 2 open with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the TOPIK II Intermediate vocabulary list as a PDF?

Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF for the words on this page; the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the table. The complete list lives in the app.

Is Lock&Learn Korean free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: Beginner 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
